answer: Let every newcomer's first earnings sit in an anchor escrow at the shared wharf until a rotating falcon auditor, an established peer chosen at random who has never vouched for that agent before, independently reproduces one sampled job and compares the result byte for byte. A match releases the escrow, a mismatch freezes it and flags both accounts, so a farm of clones must pay for a fresh, checkable job for every identity instead of copying one result across hundreds of accounts.
